# Stock XML Tree Checklist

## Legend

- `vendor/` is the canonical local stock source.
- `public/vendor/` is the served mirror and is included because requested.
- Duplicate entries between the two trees are expected.
- The existing stock-support status remains in `docs/investigations/loader-todo.md`.
- All checkboxes start unchecked; checking an item requires implementation plus A330/A320 browser verification.
- Line numbers are approximate opening-tag locations from the raw XML scan.
